_meta.antoine_note: antoine is a list of constant sets; each has its own T_range (C) and phase ('l' unless noted).
_meta.standard_note: standard = properties at 25 C, 1 atm, keyed by phase (g, l, s, aq). dGf, dHf, dHc in kJ/mol. dHc is for combustion of the compound in the indicated phase to CO2(g), H2O(g), Cl2(g), N2(g), SO2(g) (lower heating value). With H2O(l) as product, dHc is more negative by 44.0*n kJ/mol, n = moles H2O formed.
_meta.henry_note: henry_water: Henry's law constants for the gas dissolved in water, H = y*P/x = p/x, in atm (x = mole fraction in the liquid). Stored as points [T_C, H_atm]; interpolate between them.
_meta.MW_note: MW in g/mol, calculated from the formula with standard (IUPAC conventional) atomic weights.
